desc: Call this to finish rotating the secret on an old API token with a short secret. Must be paired with a call to oauth.v2.beginShortTokenRotation to start the process.

client_id.desc: Issued when you created your application. Must be the app the token being rotated was issued to.

client_secret.desc: Issued when you created your application.

token.desc: The original short xoxp token being rotated (the one passed to oauth.v2.beginShortTokenRotation). Authenticates the request.

new_token.desc: The new xoxp token returned by oauth.v2.beginShortTokenRotation.

output.desc: The now-active xoxp token, returned for confirmation

token.desc: The new xoxp access token, now active. The previous token is no longer valid.

invalid_client_id.desc: Value passed for `client_id` was invalid, or is not the app the token being rotated was issued to.

rotation_not_found.desc: No pending rotation was found for this token. Call oauth.v2.beginShortTokenRotation first, or the pending rotation may have expired.

token_too_long.desc: This token is not short enough to be rotated.
